description: Search the book 'Machine Learning with the Elastic Stack' (Collier & Azarmi, Packt 2019), the reference on designing Elastic anomaly detection jobs: bucket_span, detector functions, by/over/partition fields, influencers, population analysis, categorization, datafeeds and query_delay, model memory and job sizing, calendars, forecasting, alerting. Hybrid semantic + keyword search. Returns the 5 most relevant pages with chapter and page numbers for citation. Ask in natural language.

configuration.query:
FROM ml-book-passages METADATA _id, _index, _score
| FORK (WHERE MATCH(content_semantic, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10)
       (WHERE MATCH(content, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10)
| FUSE
| SORT _score DESC
| LIMIT 5
| KEEP chapter, chapter_title, page, content

query.description: Natural-language question or topic, e.g. 'how to choose bucket_span for sparse data'
